description: This file defines the class ServerControllerImpl, which implements the IController interface for IPC server control in the Rialto project. It provides server-side methods for managing RPC call failures, cancellations, and retrieving client information, and is part of the IPC namespace.

classes.name: ServerControllerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Rialto IPC server controller interface, managing RPC call states and client information.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the controller state (client-side method, ignored in this implementation).

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Checks if the RPC call has failed (always returns false in this implementation).

methods.name: ErrorText
methods.description: Returns the error text if the RPC call failed (returns empty string here).

methods.name: StartCancel
methods.description: Starts the cancellation of the RPC call (no operation here).

methods.name: SetFailed
methods.description: Marks the RPC call as failed with a reason string.

methods.name: IsCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the RPC call has been canceled.

methods.name: NotifyOnCancel
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked if the RPC call is canceled.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the client that made the RPC request.
